name: Yuan
source:
A man who could be said to be Yang's foster father.

One of the leaders of the Liu Huang Hui, the parent organization of the Lao-Shu. He is ranked as 4th among 6 executives.
Although Yang sought to take Yuan's life, even back in their home country, he doesn't seem to care much about it.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/piofiore/1926/]official website[/url]]
